# Plane | DHDTech.io

> Plane is DHDTech's self-hosted project management workspace for planning work items, cycles, and product roadmaps.

This instance is operated by DHDTech at https://plane.dhdtech.io. It runs the makeplane/plane
application, self-hosted and branded for DHDTech.

## Pages

- [Home](https://plane.dhdtech.io/): workspace entry point and sign-in.
- [Sign up](https://plane.dhdtech.io/sign-up): create an account.
- [Sign in](https://plane.dhdtech.io/sign-in): authenticate to an existing account.

## Notes

- The public API is served under https://plane.dhdtech.io/api/ and is not intended for crawling.
- Support: contact@dhdtech.io
